description: This file defines a PHP interface `ValueXModifiable` in the namespace `OrangeHRM\Core\Report\FilterField`. The interface specifies a method `xValueModifier` intended for preparing or modifying a string value for persistence, with an emphasis on extensibility for classes that implement it.

classes.name: ValueXModifiable
classes.description: An interface that mandates implementing classes to define how to modify or prepare the `x` value for persistence.

methods.name: xValueModifier
methods.description: A method to implement in classes that defines how to modify or process the provided string `x` before saving or further use. It accepts a nullable string and returns a nullable string.
